text: In a quantum economy, core economic variables such as supply, demand, price, and utility are treated as quantum states that exist in multiple configurations simultaneously until they are observed or measured through a transaction.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Quantum Economy and Tokenomics (2024). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4900878
abstract: In a quantum economy, traditional economic variables such as supply, demand, price, and utility are treated as quantum states that can exist in multiple configurations simultaneously until observed or measured.
